Attach the collateral inventory note documenting the $4,000,000 in eligible unencumbered Treasury bills to the operating-plan file before submission.
Confirm specific monitoring thresholds and escalation triggers with the rail operator's documentation before finalizing the monitoring section of the plan.
Align real-time settlement position monitoring with collateral monitoring during the peak window, and coordinate with treasury on any liquidity facility draws.
